resources.string: Lets Claude read what\'s on the screen when you give it a task, and tap, swipe and type for you. Zeta uses it only while Claude is calling a phone tool.
Zeta speech recognition (hands off to the system recognizer)

Long-press power for Zeta: when Zeta is the default digital assistant, long-pressing the power button on HyperOS opens Zeta\'s assistant panel instead of XiaoAi. Also lets Zeta call the tools system apps offer to XiaoAi, and lets Zeta\'s notifications show on Super Island. Scope: System Framework and System UI.
